# Procura West

> Procura West is a supply chain management consulting firm based in Calgary, Alberta. We provide outsourced procurement services for oil & gas and construction companies across Western Canada.

## What We Do

Procura West serves as a fractional procurement department for mid-size companies ($20M-$500M revenue) that don't have dedicated procurement teams. We handle:

- Services procurement and contractor sourcing
- Contract formation, negotiation, and administration
- Vendor evaluation and qualification
- RFX management (RFP, RFQ, RFI)
- Spend analysis and reporting
- Contractor compliance tracking (COR, ISN, WCB, Avetta, ISNetworld, ComplyWorks)
- Invoice review and three-way matching
- Change order administration
- Subcontractor management and onboarding
- Supply chain risk assessment

## Industries We Serve

- **Oil & Gas**: SAGD operators, midstream companies, oilfield service providers in Western Canada. MSA negotiation, field ticket reconciliation, turnaround scoping, vendor compliance, long-lead procurement.
- **Construction**: General contractors, ICI builders, industrial constructors in Alberta. Bid package development, sub-trade prequalification, contract buyout, CCDC contract administration.

## Monthly Packages

- **Foundation** - Procurement guidance, vendor evaluation, process assessment. For companies starting to formalize procurement.
- **Operations** - RFX management, contract review, invoice validation, vendor performance tracking. For companies with active projects.
- **Enterprise** - Full outsourced procurement department. Complete spend analysis, compliance tracking, executive reporting, on-site support.

All packages are month-to-month with no long-term contracts.

## Procurement Gap Analysis

A focused assessment of your supply chain across eight areas: Sourcing & Purchasing, Vendor Management, Contract Management, Subcontractor Management, Spend Visibility, Process & Documentation, Compliance & Safety, and Risk & Supply Chain Resilience. Flat fee engagement ($500-$1,500).

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is a fractional CPO?**
A fractional Chief Procurement Officer provides executive-level procurement leadership on a part-time or contracted basis. Instead of hiring a full-time CPO at $150K-$230K fully loaded, companies get the same expertise through monthly packages.

**How much does outsourced procurement cost?**
Procura West offers three tiers: Foundation (guidance and mentorship), Operations (hands-on procurement support), and Enterprise (full outsourced department). Pricing is based on company size, project count, and scope. All packages are month-to-month.

**What industries does Procura West serve?**
Oil & gas and construction companies in Western Canada, typically with 50-500 employees and $20M-$500M in revenue.

**What is a Procurement Gap Analysis?**
A structured assessment of your supply chain across eight areas. You get specific findings, dollar estimates, and a clear action plan. It is the recommended starting point before choosing a monthly package.

**Where is Procura West located?**
Calgary, Alberta. We serve clients across Western Canada including Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan.

**What compliance platforms does Procura West manage?**
COR, ISN, WCB, Avetta, ISNetworld, ComplyWorks, and ContractorCheck.
